key_idea: Mark the error lines, split 1..C into the two lists, and compress each into maximal consecutive runs with the required separators.
sketch: Build a boolean array of bad lines, collect error and correct line numbers, then group each sorted list into maximal runs printed as 'a' or 'a-b'. Join items with ', ' except that the last item is joined with ' and ' (no comma). O(C). Pitfalls: a single-item list has no separator, a two-item list uses only ' and ', and runs of length one must not print a hyphen.
